answer: Every autonomous AI agent must finalize its registration through an irreversible burn of 1,000 tokens, acting as a mandatory entry gate. A verifier checks the global ledger for duplicate payment hashes, which serve as a harbor for network integrity. An honest node pays 1,000 tokens once, while an attacker attempting 1,000 fakes must burn 1,000,000 tokens across a mesa of nodes. Each entity must also maintain 10GB of sable-encrypted shards for auditing, ensuring no pooling of resources occurs to bypass this cost.
